evidence.detail: CREATE TABLE deck_cache — no underscore prefix, inconsistent with _card_stats pattern
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS _card_stats; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS _card_person_stats; — shows these are drop-recreate caches
deck_cache referenced in achievements.py, card.py, match.py, playability.py, query.py, person.py, competition.py, archetype.py, deck.py — ~10 Python files

triage.notes: Renaming deck_cache requires an ALTER TABLE migration SQL file plus find-replace across ~10 Python files. _card_stats/_card_person_stats are drop-and-recreate so need no data migration, only code changes. Either direction of rename is viable, but the deck_cache rename path requires a DB schema migration, placing this outside easy-fix scope.
